quiet: Kate Miller wrote a book about wild orchids in 2011. It was printed in Knoxville.
Tunde Okafor spent years on the Niger delta. His history came out in 1987.
Henrik Lindqvist loves glaciers. He wrote about their valleys in 2003.
Patel and Moore measured rainfall in the Western Ghats. Their study took two years.
Marie Dubois visited the old mills of Normandy. She described each one in detail.
Lena Grant studies pollinators in the desert. Her newest book is about bees.
Pavel Novak toured the castles of Bohemia. He took hundreds of photographs.
David Hughes grew up in a Welsh coal town. He later wrote about his childhood.
